body: ## Description The page people watch. It must be readable at a glance, update live without flicker, and work on a phone. Done when: the Vitest suite passes and the bundle is under budget. ## Context The wire shapes live in the spec. Read [the radar UI](https://example.com/radar) for the project shape to copy. ## Implementation plan 1. Scaffold the project. 2. Write the tests, red first. 3.
